listing.name: Dump Your Blueprints
listing.aiSummary: Lets you remove unwanted ship blueprints from your knowledge.

description: Adds an ability to discard specific ship blueprints that you no longer want. This allows players to clean up their blueprint list by removing entries they regret learning.
descriptionHtml: Adds an ability to discard specific ship blueprints that you no longer want. This allows players to clean up their blueprint list by removing entries they regret learning.
discordPostHtml:
https://github.com/AlbertHiisky/DumpYourBlueprints/releases/latest/download/DumpYourBlueprints.zip

REEEEEEE, I HATE GREMLINS!

Okay, feelings aside, there are many situations when you think to yourself: "Damn, I wish I didn't learn that Hound(69) blueprint, I wish I could get rid of it". Now you can.
aiDescription: Adds an ability to discard specific ship blueprints that you no longer want. This allows players to clean up their blueprint list by removing entries they regret learning.
saveCompatibilityText: Use command runcode Global.getSector().getCharacterData().addAbility("dumpblueprintdatabase") to add the ability into existing save
updateCompatibilityText: Absolutely 0 functional changes since 0.97, except ability now autoadded on existing savefiles (probably).
